title: How long does Corvex keep completed jobs?

posts.author: ravi_p
posts.body: Trying to figure out how much Redis memory to budget. How long are completed jobs stored before Corvex deletes them? On 2.5.

posts.author: old_hand_42
posts.body: Corvex keeps completed jobs forever by default — they just accumulate until you run `corvex purge` manually. That's why the Redis instance keeps growing. We cron `corvex purge` nightly.

posts.author: nadia_corvex
posts.body: That's not right for 2.x. On Corvex 2.x completed jobs are pruned automatically after `retention.completed`, which defaults to **24h**. The pruner runs every 10 minutes; `corvex prune` (renamed from `corvex purge` in 2.0) just triggers it early. Failed jobs default to `retention.failed: 168h`. The 'keeps forever' behaviour was never a default — in 1.x the key was `keep_completed_days` with a default of 7 days. If you want more than a day of history on 2.x, set `retention.completed: 168h` explicitly.

posts.author: ravi_p
posts.body: Thanks — 24h default explains the memory profile we're seeing. Bumped it to 72h.
